# netbox_device_roles (Data Source)

Lists NetBox device role objects (`/api/dcim/device-roles/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_device_roles" "all" {}

data "netbox_device_roles" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "device_roles_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_device_roles.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/device-roles/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) Color. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to an empty string.
- `config_template_id` (Number) ID of the Config Template (`netbox_config_template`).
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `depth` (Number) Depth.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `device_count` (Number) Device Count.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the Device Role (`netbox_device_role`).
- `slug` (String) Slug.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.
- `url` (String) Url.
- `virtualmachine_count` (Number) Virtualmachine Count.
- `vm_role` (Boolean) Virtual machines may be assigned to this role. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
